introduction: South Carolina WIC starts with a clinic appointment or the online pre-application. Call 855-472-3432 to arrange an appointment.
description: South Carolina WIC starts with a clinic appointment or the online pre-application. Call 855-472-3432 to arrange an appointment.

sections.who: WIC serves qualifying pregnant, postpartum and breastfeeding participants, infants and children under five. Caregivers can sign up eligible children.
sections.get: Approved services include food, nutrition education and breastfeeding support at no cost.
sections.docs:
• Applicant identification.
  • Current address evidence.
  • Recent income or qualifying benefit eligibility notices.
  • Requested measurements or medical referral information.
sections.apply:
1. Start the pre-application

    Use the state WIC link or call for an appointment.

  2. Prepare the evidence

    Use the clinic checklist. A SNAP EBT card alone is not acceptable income proof.

  3. Complete the clinic review

    Discuss health and nutrition needs and learn how to use approved foods.
sections.after: Keep clinic appointments and contact staff about shopping or breastfeeding questions.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using WIC categories and intake, Document and medical checklist. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can a grandparent apply for a child?
Yes. The state welcomes grandparents and other caregivers.
Is the SNAP card enough to prove income eligibility?
No. The state checklist asks for a valid SNAP eligibility notice.
Why might I need a medical referral form?
The application checklist requests measurements and bloodwork information through its referral form.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
